crossRefs.keyword: his idols of gold. Heb. the idols of his gold. for a sin

crossRefs.note: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
crossRefs.keyword: his idols of gold. Heb. the idols of his gold. for a sin

translations.web: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.
translations.bsb: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.
translations.kjv: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
translations.asv: For in that day they shall cast away every man his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
